data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- (Documentation completeness for new config keys introduced in Tasks 4 — implicit support for "configurable" in DD1 and DD3)

## Description
Document the two new config keys in `plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md` under the merge section:
- `merge.pr_poll_interval_seconds` (integer, default 30, units: seconds) — How often the PR-mode merge loop polls CI check conclusions for the open PR. Lower values increase responsiveness at the cost of GitHub API call volume.
- `merge.pr_max_wait_seconds` (integer, default 3600, units: seconds) — Maximum time the PR-mode merge loop will wait for CI completion before exiting non-zero with the PR URL. Prevents indefinite spin on a permanently broken required check.

No script changes; documentation only.

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md (modify)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Both keys documented with defaults
  Verify: grep -q 'merge.pr_poll_interval_seconds' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md && grep -q 'merge.pr_max_wait_seconds' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
- [ ] Defaults present (30 and 3600)
  Verify: grep -E 'pr_poll_interval_seconds.*30|pr_max_wait_seconds.*3600' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md | wc -l | awk '$1 >= 2'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context.
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user.
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation: skip opus, escalate to user immediately.
data.title: Document merge.pr_poll_interval_seconds and merge.pr_max_wait_seconds
